messages:
incident-bot: [2498765432] Pager: HIGH - VPC network flapping observed for Granite (dedicated pool granite-prod-1). Potential tenant isolation. Paging slo: oncall:sre.

lee: seeing spike in retransmits on leaf switches to the cluster. Grafana shows inter-node latency jump ~2:15 UTC, TTL holes.

maria: confirmed - health checks failing for shards hosted in granite-prod-1, approx 12% of requests returning 503. Customer CSM says they are seeing degraded results in production.

jamie: @sre-oncall i'm on it, pulling k8s node events and nvidia daemonset logs. starting runbook -> "vpc-pool-network-isolation"

sre-oncall: assigned to @jamie. switching to incident channel. brief timeline: 2:12 first error alert, 2:16 automated failover attempted, 2:18 partial success, 2:20 rollbacks prevented traffic for subset.

jamie: quick dump: ```kubectl get pods -n granite-prod --selector=pool=granite-prod-1 -o wide``` shows 3 pods NotReady, network plugin flapping messages in kernel logs.

tay: I can pick packet captures from the host. suspect MTU mismatch after recent config push. who pushed network delta? @eng-platform-bot any recent changes?

eng-platform-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out net-agent v2.14 to granite-prod-1 at 01:50 UTC (rolling). No rollback recorded.

quentin: that version had an mtu fallback patch. it might be compatible but we saw issues in canary yesterday. adding @maria and @lee for triage.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) isolate affected nodes from pool (drain) 2) fallback net-agent to v2.13 on drained nodes 3) rejoin gradually 4) keep customer traffic on fallback pool. everyone ok with that?

lee: +1. can we move Granite traffic to fallback dedicated pool granite-prod-2? That minimizes impact but we need capacity check.

jamie: started draining 3 nodes now. draining logs: ```kubectl drain node-37 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data``` - expected completion ~3m per node.

csm-amelia: @customer-success on call with Granite's ops now. They're seeing partial failures in search endpoints and have flagged as P1. Asking for ETA and whether we'll offer credits.

quentin: capacity check: granite-prod-2 has ~18% headroom. we can shift critical routes (search, auth) there. non-critical batch jobs paused.

jamie: nodes drained and net-agent downgraded to v2.13 on node-37 and node-42. rejoining node-37 now. health checks passing for node-37.

lee: routing steering applied at 02:45 UTC. customer traffic shifted for the critical routes. monitoring shows 503s dropping to <1%.

incident-bot: [2498766032] Status update: Mitigation applied, customer traffic rerouted, partial restore. Incident still open while we confirm stability.

maria: next steps for post-incident: - RCA draft for customer - Exec one-pager for Granite execs - SLA credit calc and proposal - Internal postmortem with root cause and rollout mitigation (canary gating tightened)

quentin: root cause provisional: net-agent v2.14 introduced an MTU negotiation fallback that incorrectly set jumbo frames on certain kernels leading to fragmentation and inter-node retransmits. This interacted badly with our overlay network during a rolling upgrade.

tay: also capturing full tcpdumps and dmesg outputs. saving to /var/artifacts/granite/2498765432/ for later attach to RCA.

jamie: can someone own the customer comms? CSM needs an exec-friendly summary and a timeline. also need to confirm whether a credit is warranted and amount.

csm-amelia: I'll lead customer comms. I'll draft an initial note for their ops and an exec summary. Want to propose a follow-up call tomorrow 16:00 UTC.

customer-success: please include what happened, scope (affected requests/users), mitigation steps, and an ETA for RCA. they asked for impact numbers (error rate, duration windows).

lee: impact numbers quick: peak 12% 503s between 02:12-02:45 UTC. ~8k affected requests, critical routes impacted for ~33 minutes for subset. We can produce detailed logs per route.

maria: SLA credit calc: per Granite's contract, >10% outage on critical route for >30 minutes => eligible for 5% monthly credit or custom credit. we should propose a goodwill partial credit + technical remediation plan.

quentin: recommend offering 3% automatic credit + optional 2% if they accept a remediation window (preferred scheduling) and confirm patch acceptance. happy to run numbers.

jamie: internal ask: freeze net-agent v2.14 rollout to remaining pools until full RCA and canary gating enhanced. I've opened PR to stop the rollout: https://git.internal/r/net-agent/stop-2498765432

eng-platform-bot: action: rollout paused across all prod pools at 03:05 UTC.

lee: action items assigned: jamie -> finish logs and postmortem timeline; tay -> attach packet captures and kernel logs; quentin -> coordinate rollback and release notes; maria & csm-amelia -> customer comms & SLA calc; lee -> exec briefing and credit approval chain.

maria: drafting RCA skeleton now. I'll paste draft here in the thread for review.

maria: draft paste: ```Summary: On 2498765432 at ~02:12 UTC a rolling net-agent v2.14 upgrade caused MTU negotiation faults on a subset of kernels in granite-prod-1, leading to fragmentation and significant retransmits. Consequence: ~12% 503s for critical routes for ~33 min. Mitigation: drained and downgraded nodes to v2.13, rerouted traffic to granite-prod-2. Root cause: faulty mtu fallback logic in v2.14. Actions: rollback paused, canary gating to include MTU verification test, post-deployment smoke test addition, offer customer credit + remediation window.```

jamie: looks good. small edits: include exact nodes and timestamps, attach logs. Also add "why didn't automation rollback earlier" - automation failed due to partial success heuristics.

tay: adding packet capture links to RCA. ```s3://artifacts/internal/granite/2498765432/pcap-node-37.pcap```

customer-success: csm-amelia, please include a one-line apology and immediate mitigation summary at top. customers appreciate clarity.

csm-amelia: draft note to customer ops (short): "We're sorry for the disruption. Root cause identified as a network agent upgrade interaction; mitigation applied, traffic restored. We'll follow up with RCA and proposed credit. Can we schedule a 30min call at 16:00 UTC tomorrow?" ok to send?

lee: send when ready. also please CC me and quentin for exec escalation.

maria: internal exec briefing draft (one-pager): impact, timeline, customer flag, financial exposure estimate, next steps. I'll attach credit calc.

quentin: finance estimate: if we give 3% credit on a $120k/mo account that's $3.6k. If full 5% per contract it's $6k. recommend 3% + 2% contingent.

jamie: final status check: all nodes in granite-prod-1 stabilized, net-agent rollback completed for affected nodes, canary test added to pipeline. setting incident to resolved in 20m after stability window.

incident-bot: [2498768632] Incident status: Resolved (monitoring window passed). Postmortem required.

maria: closing notes: RCA draft attached, customer comms ready to send (johnny at Granite copied), exec one-pager ready. we'll schedule internal postmortem tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Thanks for swift response everyone. :heart:

lee: thanks team. follow-up tasks and owners in linear issue: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/NET-4721-granite-vpc-rca

customer-success: customer confirmed call for 16:00 UTC tomorrow. they asked to be notified when credits are applied.

csm-amelia: sending customer mail now. will post final copy here after send.

maria: posting final RCA link once uploaded: s3://artifacts/internal/granite/2498765432/rca-draft-v1.md

lee: 👍
